title: Hyle's Molding and the Cosmic Times
description: T23 traces how the proprium, taken in itself, dwells in its own ground alone and molds a counterfeit cosmos from herself: she brings forth foul forms, the dark counter-pentad (smoke, fire, wind, salt water, darkness), trees of death, fruits of self-love, and abortions that cannot live — all in mutual hatred, gathered into the chief shape of self-claiming, set to make war against the Land of Light. T24 contrasts this with the measured times of regeneration: everything that comes to be in the soul comes to be in measure; only the Lord himself has no measure. The descent moves through measured ages from the Divine Human's going down until the natural is finally loosed and the great fire purifies.
